card.name: Small linking words in instructions
card.fires_on: Small linking words or punctuation (the, of, a comma, a closing parenthesis) inside instructions, just before the next item such as a body site, a list item, or a liquid like water.

modes.label: Injection site phrasing
modes.description: The word 'the' after 'preferably in' before a muscle location.
modes.example: intramuscular injections be given preferably in<< the>> mid-lateral muscles of the thigh.

modes.label: Fluid amounts
modes.description: The word 'of' after a volume, before water.
modes.example: administered every 2 to 6 hours as a slurry with 8 mL/kg<< of>> tap water.

modes.label: List joints in drug names or steps
modes.description: A comma or parenthesis within a list of drug names or numbered steps.
